title: FitShield Android app-package dataset
description: Android application → brand mappings. Brand metadata (display name, domains, countries, tags) is NOT stored here — it is generated from engine/blocklists/*.json via `brandId` (the brand's canonical source domain). This file only records which Android package IDs belong to a brand.

defaultCategory.description: App-grouping category applied to every entry that does not override it (finer categories like coffee/dessert/grocery are derived from source metadata). Drives the Settings toggles.

brandId.description: The brand's canonical source domain in engine/blocklists/*.json (e.g. "doordash.com"). Must map to exactly one blocklist entry. Internationalized (IDN / non-ASCII) domains are permitted — this pattern mirrors the enforced BRAND_ID_RE in tools/validate-android-packages.js (a dotted host with no whitespace or URL delimiters).

packageIds.description: Android application IDs for this brand (e.g. "com.dd.doordash"). May be empty ONLY when packageStatus is "needs_review", "no_app", or "shared_app".

packageStatus.description: "active" (default) requires at least one packageId. "needs_review" is for brands whose package ID is not yet confirmed. "no_app" records a VERIFIED determination that the brand has no official Android app (so it is never re-researched). "shared_app" means the brand's official app is another blocked brand's package (e.g. a country storefront of a platform app) — the package is recorded once, on the owning brand, so every packageId maps to exactly one brand. All three non-active statuses require empty packageIds. Never guess a package ID.

category.description: Optional per-app override of the derived category.
